name: catalog/graph_export_stale
description: The invariants run (sweep, every 10 minutes) found no clean catalog graph export to BigQuery in the last 26 hours (M0 F5-R4).
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^catalog-" AND jsonPayload.message="invariant" AND jsonPayload.id="graph_export_stale" AND jsonPayload.violations>0
